WITH by_status AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count
  FROM by_status
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT archstat, project_count, 1.0 * project_count / total_count AS ratio
  FROM by_status CROSS JOIN total
),
average AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM ratios
)
SELECT ratios.archstat, ratios.project_count, ratios.ratio,
       ratios.ratio - average.avg_ratio
FROM ratios CROSS JOIN average
WHERE ratios.ratio > average.avg_ratio
